createOrReplace.excerpt: HIGH SCHOOL Admission-Average Ranges: Three-Year Trend. The following admission-average ranges reflect the past three admission cycles. Admission is competitive. Arts - Low to mid 70s. Business - Mid to high 80s. Engineering - Mid 80s to low 90s. Science - Low 80s to mid 90s.
